# A stump (generated by make_env.py), its top at 0.5 m.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.467 0.267 0.282 --no-slot
material new Rings --base-color 0.933 0.612 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Stump --vertices 8 --radius 0.45 --depth 0.48 --location 0 0 0.24
material assign Bark
add mesh cylinder --name Top --vertices 8 --radius 0.42 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0.49
material assign Rings
add mesh cube --name Root0 --size 1 --location 0.44 0.19 0.08
scale 0.35 0.16 0.16
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 22.9
material assign Bark
add mesh cube --name Root1 --size 1 --location -0.41 0.25 0.08
scale 0.35 0.16 0.16
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 149.0
material assign Bark
select all
shade flat
export stump.glb
